opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance, with at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return).
opportunities.summary: Grants of under £100,000 towards operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities for eligible UK charities. Applications are open all year round with no deadlines.

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million (organisation's income need not be over £1m).
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest all year round (no deadlines); if taken forward they are invited to submit a full proposal.
